text:
Mikael Granlund, 34 and on his sixth NHL team, is playing 20:36 a night for a Ducks team that has won six of seven. He has 20 points in 17 games and a six-game point streak, capped by a goal and three assists against Pittsburgh. Eleven of the 20 have come on the power play.

At five-on-five it is a different story. Anaheim gets just 36% of the expected goals with him on the ice, among the lowest shares in the league for a top-six forward, and the Ducks have scored 10.4 more goals than the chances deserve while he plays. His scoring rate, 3.43 points per 60, sits well above our talent range for him (about 2.1 to 2.9).

He is a smart, clean puck mover; Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 62% of his exits leaving the zone with possession. But this is the profile most likely to cool. Our projection lands him around 78 points, which would still be the best season of his career.
headline: Granlund is producing on borrowed luck
